content: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). If the symptoms are less severe, contact a poison control center without delay. Residents in the United States can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, it is essential to undergo laboratory and/or medical tests, such as assessments of kidney and liver function, potassium and magnesium levels, and complete blood counts. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as prescribed. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. For storage instructions, refer to the product guidelines and consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last updated in May 2024. Please note that this is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and your individual health requirements.
